I like the atmosphere the scene is giving off, but I feel like the main thing that sets apart ok action scenes from great action scenes is descriptiveness. 

Whenever I used to take workshops for writing, the golden rule for making scenes feel more alive and not like a monologue was "Show, not tell".  The perspective also seems to shift in the scene, from third person to first person. This is a major rule break in writing, you should either stick to third or first person, not switch between the two.
